title: Antes de Apagar as Luzes
summary: On the last mandatory day of 2026, all five Kairos teams, coaches, staff, and some family gather for an unassigned-seating holiday dinner and gift exchange. Arthur Fletcher attends in person, out of his wheelchair. Adrian gives an unplanned speech: the 2026 build phase is over, 2027 brings real competitive results (first debut window 2027-02-08), and the organization will stay the same whether Kairos wins or loses. The institutional break begins the next day.
keyEvents: Arthur Fletcher attends the party in person, standing and walking slowly without a wheelchair, having relocated to Los Angeles in December to live on campus near his grandson Owen "Glacier" Fletcher.
Adrian enforces unassigned, mixed seating across all five teams and staff, deliberately avoiding Main/Academy or League/CS seating splits.

At dinner, Mason "404" Brooks starts a round of 'best moment of the year' answers; players and staff across all five teams share moments (e.g. Atlas on the original five Counter-Strike signees becoming complete, Moss on a scrim loss with no blame-shifting, Mako on being told Hai would be Blue's coach, Pebble on Academy White's first review, Arthur on moving to Los Angeles to stop worrying about his grandson by phone).

Emily Chen runs a 'One Good Gift, One Bad Gift' exchange; notable gifts include a whistle for Moss (implicating Aphromoo), a framed 'FEBRUARY' sign for Atlas, an 'I CAN FIX IT / PLEASE DON'T LET ME' shirt for 404, a Palmeiras jersey for FLACOGOMEZ, mote con huesillo snack mix for MoteConHuesillo, 'THE OLDER TWIN' / 'BY 11 MINUTES. NOBODY CARES.' shirts for Nolan and Reid Hart, and a miniature basketball marked '1-0' for Arthur from Moss.
New Balance quietly delivers 2027 travel gear to every player's dormitory with no announcement or press.

Pressured into an impromptu speech, Adrian recaps 2026 (idea to campus to contracts to Academies to New Balance) and states that in 2027 Kairos will be judged by real results: rankings, eliminations, wins, and losses.
Adrian states explicitly that Kairos's support for its people does not depend on winning or losing, and will not change based on results.
Adrian confirms the institutional break begins the next day (2026-12-20) with players returning 2027-01-04, ahead of the February 8, 2027 competitive debut window.
2026 ends with no official Kairos match played, no win, no loss, no championship, and no ranking.
consequences: The institutional break (2026-12-20 to 2027-01-03) begins the day after this episode.
canonIntroduced: Arthur Fletcher has relocated permanently to the Kairos campus residential area in Los Angeles as family, not as staff or a competitive-program member.
New Balance's 2027 travel collection is delivered to players without any public announcement.
continuityNotes: No nickname changes occur in this episode; soupcrime, velcrodog, parkinglot, Mako, Grit, and Vex are still current throughout.
Adrian's speech establishes that 2027 is the year Kairos is judged on competitive results, contrasted with 2026's pure build-out year.

confirmedFacts: This is the last mandatory day of 2026 for all five Kairos teams.
Arthur Fletcher attends in person and has relocated to the Kairos campus residential area.
The institutional break runs 2026-12-20 through 2027-01-03, with return on 2027-01-04.
2026 ends without any official Kairos match, win, loss, championship, or ranking.
